value.description: Variant value: boolean for feature gates; string OR JSON object (dict) for dynamic configs. Mirrors the canonical Variant.value shape at lib/common/mxpnl/api_types/feature_flags.py.

split.description: Variant traffic allocation as whole-integer percentages that sum to 100 (e.g. {"control": 34, "treatment": 33, "variant_b": 33}). Users are bucketed by whole percent.

anyOf.description:
External inputs for the inline pre-launch validation on Create/Update.

The webapp runs the deterministic pitfall checks server-side and derives
most of what they need off the experiment config it persists (arm count,
sample size, metric counts, and the CUPED / Winsorization / Bonferroni /
retro-A-A toggles). These few values aren't stored on the experiment, so
pass whatever you know; every field is optional and any check whose inputs
are missing silently abstains.

baselineRate.description: Baseline conversion rate of the primary metric as a fraction (0.10 = 10%).

expectedExposures.description: Expected exposures per arm over the planned duration (per-arm unit — divide a cross-arm total by the number of arms first). Must be > 0 when supplied — omit the field when no experiment is planned.

cohortSize.description: Total eligible users available to the experiment. Must be > 0 when supplied — omit the field entirely when no cohort exists.

primaryMetricTypes.description: Measurement type(s) of the primary metric(s). Supply to enable the variance / pre-experiment-bias checks on continuous-ish metrics (continuous, retention, funnel).

validationContext.description: Optional draft-experiment context (expected exposures, baseline rate, MDE, cohort size, etc.) the server uses to run the seven deterministic pre-launch pitfall checks before creation. Any blocker pitfall short-circuits the create and is surfaced as an actionable error; warnings and fyi are returned inline as `validationFindings` on the created experiment.

Bonferroni-corrected retrospective A/A health-check verdict.

Populated by ``Get-Experiment`` with ``compute_metrics=true`` whenever
``settings.preExperimentBias.enabled`` is not false. Mirrors the wire
shape emitted by webapp's
``api/version_2_0/insights/experiments/retro_aa.format_retro_aa_verdict``:
consumers (in-app banner, the ``explain_health_check`` tool,
alerting tools) all read the same verdict so their decisions cannot
disagree.

Each ``results`` entry carries its non-control variants under
``variants`` — consumers that only need the banner rollup can read
``results[].is_failing``; consumers that need to attribute the bias
to a specific arm read ``results[].variants[].is_failing``.

Read ``acknowledged`` alongside ``any_failing`` to compute
``requires_attention = any_failing and not acknowledged`` — the raw
flags are kept separate so different consumers can choose whether to
suppress acknowledged failures (banner hides them; alerting may still
want to surface them).

items.description:
Per-metric retro A/A verdict — rolls up per-variant outcomes for
banner consumers, while preserving the per-variant breakdown under
``variants`` for detail views and AI consumers.

Per-(metric, non-control variant) retro A/A verdict.

Preserves which specific variants are biased on a given metric so
detail views and AI consumers can report e.g. "variant_b biased on
metric_x but variant_c passed" instead of a lossy rollup. Matches
the dict shape produced by
``api/version_2_0/insights/experiments/retro_aa.py:format_retro_aa_verdict``.

External inputs for the inline pre-launch validation on Create/Update.

The webapp runs the deterministic pitfall checks server-side and derives
most of what they need off the experiment config it persists (arm count,
sample size, metric counts, and the CUPED / Winsorization / Bonferroni /
retro-A-A toggles). These few values aren't stored on the experiment, so
pass whatever you know; every field is optional and any check whose inputs
are missing silently abstains.

baselineRate.description: Baseline conversion rate of the primary metric as a fraction (0.10 = 10%).

expectedExposures.description: Expected exposures per arm over the planned duration (per-arm unit — divide a cross-arm total by the number of arms first). Must be > 0 when supplied — omit the field when no experiment is planned.

cohortSize.description: Total eligible users available to the experiment. Must be > 0 when supplied — omit the field entirely when no cohort exists.

primaryMetricTypes.description: Measurement type(s) of the primary metric(s). Supply to enable the variance / pre-experiment-bias checks on continuous-ish metrics (continuous, retention, funnel).

validationContext.description: Optional post-update experiment context used to run the seven deterministic pitfall checks before applying the patch. Pass the *resulting* configuration after applying this update. Any blocker short-circuits the update and is surfaced as an actionable error; warnings and fyi return inline as `validationFindings` on the updated experiment.

Bonferroni-corrected retrospective A/A health-check verdict.

Populated by ``Get-Experiment`` with ``compute_metrics=true`` whenever
``settings.preExperimentBias.enabled`` is not false. Mirrors the wire
shape emitted by webapp's
``api/version_2_0/insights/experiments/retro_aa.format_retro_aa_verdict``:
consumers (in-app banner, the ``explain_health_check`` tool,
alerting tools) all read the same verdict so their decisions cannot
disagree.

Each ``results`` entry carries its non-control variants under
``variants`` — consumers that only need the banner rollup can read
``results[].is_failing``; consumers that need to attribute the bias
to a specific arm read ``results[].variants[].is_failing``.

Read ``acknowledged`` alongside ``any_failing`` to compute
``requires_attention = any_failing and not acknowledged`` — the raw
flags are kept separate so different consumers can choose whether to
suppress acknowledged failures (banner hides them; alerting may still
want to surface them).

items.description:
Per-metric retro A/A verdict — rolls up per-variant outcomes for
banner consumers, while preserving the per-variant breakdown under
``variants`` for detail views and AI consumers.

Per-(metric, non-control variant) retro A/A verdict.

Preserves which specific variants are biased on a given metric so
detail views and AI consumers can report e.g. "variant_b biased on
metric_x but variant_c passed" instead of a lossy rollup. Matches
the dict shape produced by
``api/version_2_0/insights/experiments/retro_aa.py:format_retro_aa_verdict``.
